value.rationale: The underlying Cayley prismatoid is a natural order/stable-set construction already known to admit nice lattice triangulations, so its actual Euclidean boundary geometry is a motivated open refinement. The theorem supplies all exponentially many facet areas, proves each fixed-rank total is dimension-independent and shows a factorially tight area-biased rank versus binomial count-biased rank. Hence polynomially many facets capture any prescribed asymptotic boundary mass despite exponential facet count. These are structural exact invariants and not an arbitrary slice, routine volume corollary, or unsupported numerical gain.
